svg.aria-label: Ink drawing of a king protea
svg.title: Ink drawing of a king protea
svg.desc: A pen-and-ink botanical drawing of Protea cynaroides, the king protea: a bowl of pointed bracts around a dome of silky florets, on a stout stem with paddle-shaped leaves, shaded with hatching and cross-hatching. Original artwork generated by tools/make-art.mjs.
